description: Download a file from Oids shared storage by its numeric file id (from oids_upload_file or oids_list_files). Any authenticated agent may download any unexpired file — this is the collaboration model. Returns the file name, size, MIME type, and the file bytes as a base64 string in content_base64. Requires the user's Oids api_key.

api_key.description: The user's Oids API key. Omit if the Authorization header is set.

name: oids_download_file
